Package io.jans.lock.trace.crypto

Interface TraceCryptoProvider

public interface TraceCryptoProvider
The crypto operations of TRACE ingestion: canonicalization, key parsing, signature verification with content digest, and receipt hashing. Select an implementation with TraceCryptoImpl.

Scopes. The Ed25519 signature covers the JCS (RFC 8785) form of the record without its top-level signature member. The content_digest covers the JCS form of the complete record, signature included.

Receipt hash. "sha256:" + hex(SHA-256(JCS(m))) where m has exactly these members: receipt_profile (TraceHashes.RECEIPT_PROFILE), evidence_domain_id, receipt_sequence (JSON integer), received_at (RFC 3339 UTC string with three fraction digits, see TraceTime), producer_id, record_id, content_digest and prev_receipt_hash.

Thread safety. Implementations are @ApplicationScoped singletons. Every method is safe for concurrent use.

Failures are reported as TraceCryptoException; messages carry no key material, signature bytes or record content.

Yuriy Movchan
